[Title: South Korean Lawmaker Proposes Virtual Asset AML Bill, Exchanges Face Fines of Up to 100 Million Won: Why Is Regulation Closing In on Exchanges?]

A South Korean lawmaker has proposed a new law to strengthen anti-money laundering oversight of cryptocurrencies. Exchanges that fail to conduct due diligence could face hefty fines, sharply increasing compliance pressure on the industry.

Kim Hyun-jung, a lawmaker from South Korea’s Democratic Party, has proposed amending the Act on Reporting and Use of Certain Financial Transaction Information. The amendment would require cryptocurrency exchanges to record the identity information of both parties to each transaction. Exchanges that fail to properly carry out procedures such as customer verification could face fines of up to 100 million won (about $54,000). South Korean cryptocurrency exchanges currently rely mainly on third-party services for customer verification. The new bill could force them to build their own systems, potentially driving compliance costs up significantly.

Market impact
- Short term: The impact on sentiment will likely be greatest for domestic South Korean exchanges, potentially raising compliance concerns and shifting funds toward jurisdictions with more crypto-friendly regulations.
- Medium term: If the bill passes, it will force exchanges worldwide to raise their anti-money laundering standards. Compliance costs across the industry will generally increase, but the measures could help reduce the flow of illicit funds.

My take
This regulatory move is mainly aimed at clarifying exchanges’ responsibilities. It is likely to weigh on exchange sentiment in the short term, but in the long run, it should benefit the healthy development of the industry. Go easy on me if I’m wrong—I’m just testing the waters with a small position.

[标题：韩国议员提虚拟资产AML法案，交易所罚款最高1亿韩元：为什么监管要围堵交易所？]

韩国议员提议新法加强加密货币反洗钱监管，交易所若未尽职需付巨额罚款，对行业合规压力陡增。

韩国民主党议员金 Hyun-jung 提出修改《特定金融交易信息报告使用法案》，要求加密货币交易所必须记录交易双方身份信息。如果交易所未妥善执行客户验证等操作，将面临最高1亿韩元（约合5.4万美元）的罚款。目前韩国加密货币交易所主要通过第三方服务进行客户验证，新法案可能迫使它们建立自有系统，合规成本或将大幅上升。

对市场的影响
- 短期：对韩国本土交易所情绪影响最大，可能引发合规担忧，资金流向或转向监管更友好的地区。
- 中期：若法案通过，将迫使全球交易所提高反洗钱标准，行业合规成本普遍上升，但有利于减少非法资金流入。

我的判断
这次监管动作主要是为了解决交易所责任界定问题，短期内对交易所情绪偏空，但长期看有利于行业健康发展。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试。

ETHV quarterly report: creations and redemptions nearly offset | Fund does not stake | ETH $1,845 confirmation level

My stance is to watch, not to treat the words “Ethereum ETF” as a uniform buy signal. VanEck’s ETHV filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission shows that in the third quarter, the fund created 550,000 shares and redeemed 525,000, for a net increase of just 25,000 shares. Over the same period, net assets rose from about $77.83 million to $132.8 million, an increase of about 70.69%. The filing explains that the ETH price used to value the fund rose about 69.51% from the end of June to the end of September, so the jump in assets was mainly due to price revaluation—not a surge in new inflows. These are quarterly figures through September 30; they should not be described as 550,000 new shares being subscribed for on November 18.

The product mechanics are easier to overlook. ETHV’s prospectus explicitly states that the fund does not stake ETH and therefore does not receive staking rewards. By contrast, other funds on the market allow some ETH to be staked and may distribute the resulting yield. Buying the same underlying coin does not mean the fees, return profile, or redemption liquidity are the same. ETHV’s quarterly report also states that authorized participants can create and redeem baskets in the primary market using cash or in-kind ETH: for cash creations, the fund buys coins from liquidity providers; for in-kind creations, ETH is delivered to the fund. Cash redemptions involve the fund selling coins, while in-kind redemptions involve delivering ETH. Investors trading fund shares with one another in the secondary market do not necessarily trigger the fund to buy or sell an equivalent amount of spot ETH in real time. Treating every ETF trade on an exchange as a spot ETH buy is a misunderstanding of the mechanics.

What does this mean for the price of ETH? I would first distinguish the ETF’s actual net creations and redemptions, then look at changes in holdings, staking ratios, and whether there is any need to sell coins for cash. ETHV created 22 baskets and redeemed 21 in the third quarter, showing activity on both sides but a small net amount. Headlines focusing on just one side can exaggerate marginal demand. The prospectus’s no-staking policy also means ETHV holders cannot share in network staking rewards, but they avoid an additional layer of staking unlock and slashing risk. This is a product trade-off, not evidence of holders’ directional view on ETH.

When I checked Binance ETH/USDT, the price was about $1,819.07, up about 0.34% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $1,751.39 to $1,843.49. The price has rebounded from its low but has not broken above the top of the range; this rebound also cannot be attributed to a quarterly report from several days ago. $1,845 is the short-term confirmation level, while around $1,751 is the downside invalidation level. If the price breaks above $1,845 but quickly falls back below $1,810, that would suggest the chase may lack follow-through. A break below $1,751 would invalidate the current rebound structure. Farside’s ETF-by-ETF data for November 17 still needs a complete update. I will not interpret blank fields as zero, nor use historical quarterly reports to fill in that day’s fund flows.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only a spot long, with a position capped at 2% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger would be an hourly ETH close above $1,845, followed by a retest that holds above $1,838, while BTC has not simultaneously broken below its low for the day. The first target is $1,880, where I would cut the position in half; the second target is $1,920, where I would reduce most of the remainder. I would set the initial stop at $1,808. If two consecutive hourly candles close back below $1,820 after the breakout, I would exit the entire position early. I would close any remaining position near $1,920 or if there is no continued move higher within 24 hours of entry. If the price breaks below $1,751 first, I would cancel the long plan.

content:
ETHV季报申赎近抵消｜基金不参与质押｜ETH等1845确认

我的态度是观察，不把“以太坊ETF”四个字直接当作统一的买盘信号。VanEck旗下ETHV向美国证监会提交的三季报显示，第三季度基金创设55万份、赎回52.5万份，净增只有2.5万份；同期净资产从约7783万美元升至1.328亿美元，增幅约70.69%。文件解释，基金计价采用的ETH价格在6月末至9月末上涨约69.51%，所以资产规模跃升主要是价格重估，不等于新增资金暴增。这里说的是截至9月30日的季度数据，不能写成11月18日又有55万份新申购。

更容易被忽略的是产品机制。ETHV招募说明书明确写明基金不参与ETH质押，因此不会取得质押奖励。相反，市场上另有允许部分ETH参与质押并可能分配收益的基金；买的是同一种底层币，却不代表费用、收益路径或赎回流动性相同。ETHV季报还写明，授权参与者可用现金或实物ETH进行一级市场篮子申赎：现金申购由基金向流动性提供方买币，实物申购则交付ETH；现金赎回涉及基金卖币，实物赎回则交付ETH。二级市场投资者互相买卖基金份额，本身不必然触发基金实时买卖等量现货。把交易所里每一次ETF成交都当作ETH现货买盘，是对机制的误读。

这对ETH价格有什么用？我会先分辨ETF的真实净申赎，再看持币变化、质押比例和是否存在现金卖币需求。ETHV三季度22篮创设、21篮赎回，说明两边都很活跃，净额却小；单看一边的新闻标题容易夸大边际需求。招募说明书对不质押的安排还提示，ETHV持有人无法分享网络质押奖励，但少了一层质押解锁与罚没风险。这是产品取舍，不能推断持有人对ETH的方向。

截至查询币安ETH/USDT时，现价约1819.07美元，近24小时上涨约0.34%，区间1751.39至1843.49美元。价格从低位回升但未越过上沿，这段反弹也不能归因于一份数日前的季报。1845美元是短线确认线，1751美元附近是下方失效线。若突破1845后很快跌回1810，说明追价可能缺乏延续；若跌破1751，当前反弹结构被推翻。Farside的11月17日ETF逐只数据仍需等待完整更新，我不会把空栏解释成零，也不会用历史季报填补当日资金流。

如果是我自己交易，当前不参与，方向只考虑现货试多，仓位最多为总资金2%，不用杠杆。入场触发是ETH一小时收盘站上1845美元，随后回踩1838美元仍守住，同时BTC没有同步跌破当日低点。第一目标1880美元，到位减仓一半；第二目标1920美元，再减去大部分。初始止损设在1808美元；若突破后连续两根一小时K线收回1820美元下方，提前全部平仓。剩余仓位在1920美元附近或入场后24小时没有延续上涨时全部退出。若先跌破1751美元，取消做多计划。

translatedData.subTitle:
Everyone wants to double their money overnight, but the people who really hold on to their money in this market are the ones who “get rich slowly.”
Let’s do the math: earning just 1% a day over 250 trading days in a year gives you 12x your money; at a steady 10% a month,
you’d have 30x your money after three years. It may not sound exciting, but it has one remarkable advantage—it doesn’t depend on luck.

Doubling your money depends on market conditions; compounding depends on discipline. You wait for market opportunities, but discipline is up to you. Don’t set your goal
as “double my money this week.” Set it as “make no major mistakes this week.” The money from the first goal comes from the market,
but the ability behind the second is yours. The market is open every day, but only those who preserve their capital are able to keep playing.

Why Did $3.8 Million Vanish Overnight from Kava Lend? KAVA’s 39% Crash Exposes an Ecosystem Vulnerability

Kava Lend, a lending protocol in the Kava ecosystem, was attacked, losing $3.8 million and sending the price of KAVA tumbling 39%—a stark reminder of how vulnerable DeFi protocols can be.

On-chain data shows that attackers targeted Kava Lend, a lending platform in the Kava ecosystem, late Friday night. They inflated a modest BUSD deposit by 243,000 times, then went on a borrowing spree, taking nearly all the KAVA tokens in the protocol—worth about $3.8 million at the time. The attackers later transferred the stolen tokens to BNB Chain and sold roughly $2.1 million worth. As a result, KAVA plunged nearly 40%. The Kava team says it will investigate, but the incident has once again put DeFi security under scrutiny.

Market impact
- Short term: KAVA’s plunge could drive risk-averse investors out of the Kava ecosystem, while other similar lending protocols may face the risk of a run. BNB Chain could see a short-lived boost as the attackers move funds there to cash in on arbitrage.
- Medium term: The incident could draw more regulatory attention to the oversight of decentralized finance, potentially leading to stricter compliance requirements in the future. However, as long as Kava remains standing, other players should move quickly to strengthen their security measures.

My take
KAVA will probably continue to grind lower in the short term, but it depends on whether it can hold the psychologically important $15 level. If it keeps falling on rising volume, that could signal a real change in trend. If KAVA holds above $15, at least it would suggest that the smart money hasn’t all left. This outlook would need to be reconsidered if regulators suddenly move to shut down bridges to BNB Chain.

- Medium term: This is another major vote of confidence in Bitcoin ETFs. If more Wall Street giants follow suit, ETF buying will continue. Seeing this, regulators may be more inclined to give the crypto industry a “you deserve to be seen” look.

If you’re in New York, you may have wanted to use your crypto on Coinbase as collateral to borrow stablecoins, but that option was unavailable. It’s now open—but don’t take that to mean that “all borrowing features are now available.”

On November 17, Morpho stated in an official blog post that Coinbase Borrow, which uses Morpho to provide on-chain lending infrastructure on the Base network, is now available to New York users. Coinbase’s Help Center also says that New York users can only take out floating-rate loans, and that eligible collateral is limited to Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana. Coinbase also confirmed to the media that the launch was approved by the New York State Department of Financial Services. New York was the only state where the service had not previously been available, so it now covers all 50 U.S. states. The product launched in January 2025, and Morpho says it has issued more than $3.4 billion in loans to date.

A few points that matter directly to everyday users 👇

🔹 You borrow USDC, a dollar-pegged stablecoin, without having to sell your collateral first. According to the loan limits published by Coinbase, you can borrow up to $5 million against Bitcoin, $1 million against Ethereum, and $100,000 against Solana. The amount you can actually borrow also depends on the amount of collateral and your account limits.

🔹 What’s now available in New York is fairly limited. The Help Center says that only floating-rate loans are available. Fixed-rate loans, other types of collateral such as tokenized gold and XRP, and the separate USDC lending product are all still unavailable to New York users, according to Coinbase.

🔹 This isn’t a risk-free way to get “some extra cash.” Coinbase says the collateral is transferred to a Morpho smart contract. If the loan-to-value ratio reaches around 86%, your collateral may be automatically liquidated, and a penalty may be charged. Each loan, including an additional draw on an existing loan, incurs a one-time fee that is added to the principal and continues to accrue interest. The terms also warn that borrowed funds cannot be used to trade on Coinbase.

Practical tip: If you’re in New York and already use Coinbase, first check whether the borrowing option appears in the app. Then review the interest rate, fees, liquidation threshold, and eligible collateral. Don’t assume that “now available in New York” means the features are exactly the same as in other states.

Which matters more to you: “being able to get some stablecoins without selling your crypto,” or the restrictions, such as liquidation thresholds and fees?

人在纽约，以前想在Coinbase里把币抵押出去借稳定币，这个入口是关着的。现在开了，但先别理解成「所有借贷功能都已放开」。

11月17日，Morpho在官方博客里写明：由它在Base网络上提供链上借贷设施的Coinbase Borrow，已向纽约用户开放。Coinbase帮助中心目前也写明：纽约用户只能办理浮动利率贷款，抵押品仅限比特币、以太坊和Solana。Coinbase还向媒体证实，此次上线已获得纽约州金融服务局批准；纽约是此前唯一未开放的州，至此这项服务覆盖美国全部50个州。这项产品2025年1月上线，Morpho称累计放贷已超过34亿美元。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 借出来的是美元稳定币USDC，抵押品不用先卖掉。按Coinbase公布的额度，比特币最高可借500万美元，以太坊100万美元，Solana 10万美元，实际能借多少还取决于抵押数量和账户限额。

🔹 纽约这次放开的范围比较窄。帮助中心写明只有浮动利率；固定利率，以及代币化黄金、XRP等其他抵押品，还有单独的USDC出借理财，官方都说目前还不对纽约开放。

🔹 这不是无风险的「多一笔现金」。官方说明，抵押会被转到Morpho的智能合约里；贷款价值比达到约86%就可能被自动清算，并加收罚金。每次借款（包括给已有贷款加借）都会收一笔一次性手续费，计入本金并继续计息。条款还提示：借出来的钱不能拿去在Coinbase上交易。

实用建议：如果人在纽约、已经用Coinbase，先到App里确认能否看到借款入口，再核对利率、手续费、清算线和可用抵押，不要把「纽约已开放」理解成和其他州功能完全一样。

你更在意「不用卖币也能先周转一笔稳定币」，还是更在意清算线和手续费这些限制？

#Coinbase抵押借贷已对纽约开放 #BTC #ETH

Russian Central Bank retail list takes effect | XMR not included in retail scope | Wait and see below 523

My stance on XMR is cautious and watchful. An official statement released by the Russian Central Bank on November 6 clearly states that the list of crypto assets available to non-qualified investors includes only Bitcoin, Ether, and USDT, and that the relevant rules take effect on November 17. Non-qualified investors can buy listed assets through intermediaries such as brokers, asset management firms, or crypto exchange firms. The annual purchase limit through any single intermediary is 300,000 rubles, and buyers must complete the relevant tests and risk disclosures. XMR is not on this list for ordinary investors; that is a verifiable fact. But this should not be recast as Russia imposing a comprehensive ban on holding XMR, nor should anyone claim that qualified investors are also excluded. The Central Bank’s original statement also says qualified investors may access all crypto assets, subject to the relevant tests and rules.

Another point that is easy to confuse is the timing for trading venues. A November 11 announcement by the Russian Central Bank says exchanges may begin offering crypto trading as early as November 22, provided their trading rules receive regulatory approval. So “the retail list takes effect on November 17” and “local exchanges fully open XMR trading on November 17” are entirely different things. For XMR, the policy mechanism mainly concerns the scope of potential new retail access: BTC, ETH, and USDT have a regulatory pathway for inclusion, while XMR remains outside the current list for non-qualified investors. In the short term, Russia’s retail market opening should not be treated as a positive demand catalyst for XMR. But this policy alone also cannot tell us how far XMR’s global price might fall, since whether trading launches in Russia, actual account openings and trades, and liquidity in overseas markets all remain to be seen.

I also distinguish regulatory channels from the technical network. The list determines which assets regulated intermediaries may sell to which types of clients; it does not mean the Monero blockchain will stop operating or that its privacy features will change. Monero’s official GitHub shows that the latest release remains v0.18.5.4, dated October 17, with no new mainnet upgrade announcement seen this time. Current trending topics on Binance Square are focused on macroeconomics, AI earnings, and events involving other coins, so I won’t borrow unrelated trending hashtags.

At the time I checked Kraken’s public XMR/USD market data, the latest trade was around $509.47, the daily open was around $493.58, and the rolling 24-hour range was $489.66 to $523.29. The price has rebounded from the daily open, but has yet to break the previous high. This rebound cannot be attributed to Russia’s new rules, and a quote from a single exchange cannot establish global trading volume. $523.30 is the upside confirmation level, and $489.66 is the downside invalidation level. If the price pushes above the previous high but then falls back below $510, it may indicate insufficient follow-through from buyers chasing the move. If it breaks below $489.66, the current rebound structure is invalidated. The policy does not directly create these price levels; it only changes my expectations for additional demand. Execution still depends on price confirmation.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now. The only direction I would consider is a small spot long, capped at 1.5% of total capital, with no leverage. The entry trigger would be an XMR one-hour close above $523.30, followed by a pullback that holds $520, while the bid-ask spread does not widen noticeably. The first target is $540, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target is $555, where I would reduce most of the remaining position. The initial stop-loss would be $508. If, after breaking out, two consecutive one-hour candles close back below $515, I would exit the entire position early. I would close any remaining position near $555 or if the price has not continued rising within 24 hours of entry. If the price first breaks below $489.66, I would cancel the long plan. The regulatory list is now in effect, but access through trading channels and actual demand still need to be verified.

#XMR #BTC #ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
俄央行零售清单生效｜XMR未列入零售范围｜523前观望

我的态度是对XMR谨慎观望。俄罗斯央行11月6日发布的正式说明明确，面向非合格投资者的加密资产名单只有比特币、以太币和USDT，相关规定从11月17日起生效。非合格投资者可以通过经纪商、资管机构或加密兑换机构等中介购买名单内资产，单一中介渠道的年度购买上限为30万卢布，并须完成相应测试和风险阅读。XMR不在这份普通投资者名单里，这是可核实的事实；但不能把它改写成俄罗斯全面禁止持有XMR，更不能说合格投资者也被排除。央行原文同时指出，合格投资者可接触所有加密资产，仍需遵循相关测试与规则。

另一个容易混淆的时点是交易场所。俄罗斯央行11月11日的公告说，交易所最早可从11月22日开展加密交易，前提是其交易规则获得监管同意。所以“零售清单11月17日生效”和“本地交易所11月17日已全面开放XMR交易”完全不是同一件事。对XMR而言，政策机制主要是潜在新增零售入口的覆盖范围：BTC、ETH和USDT有被列入的制度路径，XMR在现有非合格投资者名单之外，短期不能把俄罗斯零售开放当作XMR需求利好。但也不能仅凭这项政策推算XMR全球价格会跌多少，因为俄罗斯交易是否启动、实际开户与成交、境外市场流动性都尚需观察。

我还会把监管渠道与技术网络分开。名单决定受监管中介向哪类客户销售，并不意味着Monero链停止运行或隐私属性改变。Monero官方GitHub显示正式版本仍是10月17日的v0.18.5.4，本轮未见新主网升级公告。币安广场当前上升话题集中在宏观、AI财报与其他币种事件，我不借用不相关的热门标签。

截至查询Kraken XMR/USD公开行情时，最新成交约509.47美元，日开约493.58美元，滚动24小时区间489.66至523.29美元。价格较日开反弹，但尚未突破前高；这段反弹不能归因于俄罗斯新规，也无法从单个交易所报价推出全球成交量。523.3美元是上方确认线，489.66美元是下方失效线。若冲过前高又跌回510美元，说明追价可能不足；若跌破489.66美元，眼前的反弹结构被推翻。政策不直接生成这些价位，它只改变我对新增需求的预期，执行仍看价格确认。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓试多，仓位上限为总资金1.5%，不用杠杆。入场触发是XMR一小时收盘站上523.3美元，随后回踩520美元仍守住，同时盘口买卖价差没有明显扩大。第一目标540美元，到位减仓一半；第二目标555美元，再减去大部分。初始止损放在508美元；若突破后两根一小时K线重新收在515美元下方，则提前全部平仓。剩余仓位在555美元附近或入场后24小时没有延续上涨时全部退出。若先跌破489.66美元，取消做多计划。监管清单已经生效，但渠道开放和实际需求还需要继续验证。

#XMR #BTC #ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

Ethereum (ETH) Market Depth Analysis: ETFs Continue to Bleed, but Smart Money Starts Buying the Dip

I. Price Action Analysis

As of the early hours of November 18, Beijing time, Ethereum was trading at $1,811. Over the past 24 hours, its price rose gradually from around $1,790 to a high of $1,822, showing a moderate overall uptrend. Notably, during the sharp correction beforehand, Ethereum briefly fell to a low of $1,778, but quickly recovered its losses as whale buying drove a rebound.

On the hourly chart, the latest five candlesticks show a staircase-like advance, with each candle reaching progressively higher highs and lows. In terms of trading volume, turnover peaked at $30.56 million per hour during the rebound, indicating substantial capital behind the price rise. The current price has approached the middle Bollinger Band, near $1,811, where bulls and bears are locked in a fierce contest.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

In terms of moving averages, the current price has just climbed above the 7-day moving average at $1,802, but remains below the 25-day moving average at $1,813 and the 99-day moving average at $1,830. The three moving averages are bearishly aligned, indicating that the medium-term downtrend has yet to reverse and that the short-term rebound faces layers of resistance from the moving-average system.

The MACD indicator has shown a positive shift: its histogram has moved from negative to positive territory, with the latest reading reaching 1.67. The DIF line is crossing above the DEA line, forming a bullish golden cross. Although the MACD's absolute value remains negative, this directional change deserves attention.

The RSI indicator shows that the 6-period RSI has climbed above 68, nearing overbought territory. The 12-period RSI is around 56, while the 24-period RSI has just broken above the 51 midpoint. Short-term rebound momentum is strong, but further upside may be limited by overbought conditions.

The KDJ indicator is performing strongly: the K-line has crossed above the D-line, forming a golden cross, and the J-value has broken above 100 into overbought territory, signaling strong short-term bullish momentum. The Williams indicator has also quickly recovered from -53 to -13, confirming short-term strength.

Across 15 quantitative factors, five signal a buy, nine signal a sell, and one is neutral. Although bearish factors remain in the majority, the composite indicator's win rate is as high as 83.33%, suggesting that the current buy signal is relatively reliable.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum faces a complex market environment. On one hand, spot Ethereum ETFs continue to see redemptions, with net outflows of $399 million for the week last week and $8.4 million on November 16 alone. The withdrawal of institutional capital continues to weigh on the price. On the other hand, a wallet linked to the Binance hacker transferred approximately 75,000 ETH, worth $137 million. Although the funds have not yet been sold, the potential selling pressure cannot be ignored.

However, smart money is positioning itself against the trend. Analysts report that institutional investors are actively building long positions in Ethereum at lower prices. Growth in ETF holdings during the third quarter also suggests that long-term investors' confidence in the Ethereum ecosystem remains intact. In addition, while the news that Zelle chose Solana for global payments is positive for Solana, growing momentum in the payments sector as a whole may also draw greater attention to the broader crypto ecosystem.

Overall, Ethereum's short-term technical picture is showing signs of a rebound, with the MACD golden cross and overbought KDJ both pointing to near-term upward momentum. However, the medium-term trend remains bearish, and the 99-day moving average at $1,830 is an important resistance level. A decisive break above it could open the way toward $1,850. The lower Bollinger Band at $1,775 is key support.

以太坊ETH市场深度分析：ETF持续失血但聪明钱开始抄底

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十一月十八日凌晨，以太坊现货报价一千八百一十一美元，过去二十四小时价格从一千七百九十美元附近起步，逐步攀升至一千八百二十二美元的高位，整体呈现温和上涨态势。值得注意的是，在此前的大幅回调中，以太坊一度跌至一千七百七十八美元的低位，但随后在鲸鱼资金的抄底推动下迅速收复失地。

从小时K线来看，最近五根K线呈现阶梯式上涨格局，每根K线的高点和低点都在逐步抬升。成交量方面，反弹高峰时段成交额达到每小时三千零五十六万美元，显示有较为充足的资金在推动价格上涨。当前价格已经逼近布林带中轨一千八百一十一美元附近，多空双方在此位置展开激烈争夺。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，当前价格刚刚站上七日均线一千八百零二美元，但仍然低于二十五日均线一千八百一十三美元和九十九日均线一千八百三十美元。三条均线呈空头排列，说明中期下行趋势尚未扭转，短线反弹面临均线系统的层层压制。

MACD指标出现积极转变，柱状图从负值区域转正，最新读数达到一点六七，DIF线正在上穿DEA线，形成看涨金叉信号。虽然MACD的绝对数值仍然为负，但方向性的转变值得重视。

RSI指标显示，六周期RSI已经攀升至六十八以上，接近超买区域，十二周期RSI在五十六附近，二十四周期RSI刚突破五十一中轴。短线反弹动能较强，但继续上行的空间可能受到超买压力的限制。

KDJ指标表现亮眼，K线已经上穿D线形成金叉，J值突破一百进入超买区域，显示短线多头力量强劲。威廉指标从负五十三快速回升至负十三，同样确认了短线强势。

综合十五个量化因子来看，五个发出做多信号，九个发出做空信号，一个中性。虽然空头因子仍占多数，但综合指标的胜率高达百分之八十三点三三，说明当前做多信号的可靠性较高。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊面临的市场环境较为复杂。一方面，现货以太坊ETF持续遭遇赎回，上周单周流出三点九九亿美元，十一月十六日单日流出八百四十万美元，机构资金的撤离对价格形成了持续压制。另一方面，与Binance黑客相关的钱包转移了约七万五千枚以太坊，价值一亿三千七百万美元，虽然尚未变现，但潜在的抛压不容忽视。

然而，聪明钱正在逆势布局。分析师报告称，机构投资者在较低价位积极积累以太坊多头头寸，ETF在第三季度的增长也显示长期资金对以太坊生态的信心并未动摇。此外，Zelle选择Solana进行全球支付的消息虽然利好Solana，但整体支付赛道的升温也有助于提升市场对整个加密生态的关注度。

总体来看，以太坊短线技术面出现反弹信号，MACD金叉和KDJ超买都指向短期上涨动能。但中期趋势仍然偏空，上方一千八百三十美元的九十九日均线是重要阻力位。如果能够有效突破，有望打开向一千八百五十美元进军的空间。下方一千七百七十五美元的布林带下轨是关键支撑。

translatedData.title: Trading Psychology | A stop-loss isn’t admitting you’re wrong—it’s the price of admission to your next opportunity
translatedData.subTitle:
Many people struggle to place a stop-loss because they see it as proof that “I was wrong,” and their pride
gets in the way. Try looking at it another way: a stop-loss is insurance you bought in advance; the premium is that small loss.
The difference between a professional trader and a gambler isn’t who’s more accurate, but who allows themselves to be wrong.

The most steady-handed traders I’ve ever seen cut their losses more decisively than anyone when they’re wrong. Because they know: whether this trade is right or wrong
doesn’t matter. What matters is the expected value over a hundred trades. The next time your hand trembles as you place a stop-loss, tell yourself
this is the price of admission, not a verdict.

Morgan Stanley discloses ETH fund | Staking yield depends on redemption constraints | Wait until 1845 breaks

My stance is neutral to cautiously bearish. The Binance Square trending topics are still discussing institutional holdings and tech stocks, but for ETH right now, the more worthwhile read is the formal filings of institutional products themselves. Morgan Stanley Ethereum Trust (MSSE) recently filed its third-quarter report with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, showing that as of September 30, the fund held approximately 20,000.27 ETH, with a fair value of approximately $53.89 million and net assets of approximately $53.92 million; about 70% of its ETH was staked at the time. From the start of operations on July 27 through September 30, it accumulated approximately $35,100 in net staking rewards. The capital corresponding to shares subscribed during the same period was approximately $42.41 million, and the filing showed no redemptions during that period. Morgan Stanley’s website also explicitly states that the product provides exposure to the price of ETH, with staking rewards accruing to the trust rather than being paid directly into each investor’s wallet. Every figure here has a report cutoff date; these should not be treated as real-time holdings or same-day net inflows on November 18.

The significance of this report for ETH is that institutional holdings and staking are now part of an auditable product structure, so demand can no longer be assessed solely by watching spot orders on exchanges. But a high staking rate also creates liquidity constraints: if redemptions are concentrated in the future, staked ETH will need to queue to exit, and the fund will need to retain some unstaked ETH to meet subscriptions and redemptions. The filing itself flags slashing, operational, and exit-delay risks associated with staking. So I wouldn’t interpret 70% as permanently locked up, nor would I attribute all growth in net asset value on the books to staking; the approximately $11.48 million in unrealized appreciation during the reporting period was mainly affected by changes in the price of ETH. Institutional participation is a medium- to long-term structural fact, but short-term buying still depends on new subscriptions and price confirmation.

The signals the market has given so far are not strong. When I checked Binance ETH/USDT, the current price was approximately $1,815.72, down about 0.89% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $1,751.39 to $1,843.49; the price has yet to reclaim the top of the range. Farside’s tally showed net outflows of approximately $8.4 million from U.S. ETH funds on November 16. These cannot be offset against MSSE’s quarter-end holdings, and full-day closing fund flows for November 17 cannot be stated as known before settlement. Around $1,845 is the upside confirmation level I’m watching; around $1,751 is the current low. If the price breaks above $1,845 but falls back within an hour, the institutional narrative is not enough to justify chasing the trade; if it loses $1,751, the rebound thesis needs to be reassessed. Figures from different platforms and cutoff dates cannot be mechanically combined to infer same-day net buying.

If I were trading myself, I would sit out for now. My only tentative directional bias is a spot long, with a position size capped at 3% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger is an hourly close above $1,845, followed by a retest that holds above $1,840, provided BTC has not simultaneously broken below its own intraday low. The first target is $1,875, where I would reduce the position by half; the second target is $1,910, where I would reduce most of the remainder. I would set the initial stop-loss at $1,810, and exit early if the price falls back below $1,840 on increased volume after entry. I would close the remaining position around $1,910 or in full if there is no follow-through within 24 hours of entry. If the price first breaks below $1,751, I would cancel this long setup. The filing gives me a framework for observation; execution still depends on new capital, price action, and a predetermined maximum loss.

#ETH

摩根士丹利披露ETH基金｜质押收益要看赎回约束｜1845未破先等

我的态度是中性偏谨慎。币安广场热榜仍在讨论机构持仓与科技股，但ETH眼下更值得读的是机构产品自己的正式文件。摩根士丹利以太坊信托MSSE近期提交美国证监会的三季报显示：截至9月30日，基金持有约20000.27枚ETH，公允价值约5389万美元，净资产约5392万美元；当时约70%的ETH处于质押状态。它从7月27日开始运营至9月30日，累计净质押奖励约3.51万美元，同期申购份额对应资本约4241万美元，文件列示该期间没有赎回。摩根士丹利官网也明确产品提供ETH价格敞口，质押奖励归入信托而非直接发到每位投资者钱包。这里每个数字都有报告截止日，不能当成11月18日实时持仓或当日净流入。

这份报告对ETH的意义，是机构持币和质押已经进入可审计披露的产品结构，需求不再只靠交易所现货下单观察。但质押率高也带来流动性约束：若未来赎回集中，已质押ETH需要排队退出，基金需保留未质押部分应对申赎。文件自己提示质押存在罚没、运营和退出时滞风险。所以我不会把70%理解成“永久锁仓”，也不会把账面净资产上涨全部归功于质押；报告期约1148万美元的未实现升值主要受ETH价格变化影响。机构参与是中长期结构事实，短线买盘仍要靠新申购和价格确认。

市场已经给出的信号并不强。截至查询币安ETH/USDT时，现价约1815.72美元，近24小时跌约0.89%，区间1751.39至1843.49美元；价格尚未重新站上区间上沿。Farside汇总的11月16日美国ETH基金净流出约840万美元，与季末MSSE存量不能相互抵消，11月17日完整日终资金也不能在未结算前写成已知。1845美元附近是我观察的上方确认位；1751美元附近是当前低点。若价格突破1845却在一小时内退回，机构叙事不足以支持追单；若失守1751，反弹判断需要重做。不同平台、不同截止日的数字不可硬拼出单日净买入。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向仅预设现货试多，仓位最多占总资金3%，不用杠杆。入场触发是一小时收盘站上1845美元，回踩不跌破1840美元，且BTC没有同步跌破自身日内低点。第一目标1875美元，到位减仓一半；第二目标1910美元，再减去大部分。初始止损放在1810美元，若入场后放量跌回1840下方则提前退出；余仓在1910附近或入场后24小时没有延续时全部平仓。若先跌破1751，取消这个多头计划。文件给我观察框架，执行仍只认新资金、价格和事先定好的损失上限。

title: 滚仓：富贵险中求，还是爆仓加速器？
subTitle:
滚仓这个词最近很火，故事都一样：小本金几倍杠杆吃大趋势，滚动几次
翻几十倍。今天讲讲它没告诉你的部分。

【滚仓在干什么】浮盈不再落袋，而是当成新仓位的风险金继续开仓，
相当于拿市场的钱加杠杆。趋势不停，复利惊人；趋势一停，从浮盈
几十个点到归零，也就一两根大阴线的事。

【数学真相】滚仓的本质是「连续押对」。假设每次胜率60%，连对四次
的概率只有13%。你看到的一夜翻倍帖，背后是99个已经删号的人。
幸存者偏差是这个行业最贵的东西。

【如果你一定要试】1. 只用你亏光了也不心疼的那部分钱；2. 浮盈滚动
到一定倍数，强制抽出本金，用「市场的钱」继续滚；3. 提前写好清零
预案。滚仓是烟花，不是过日子。别拿过日子的钱，放烟花。

你怎么看？评论区聊聊你的经历。

translatedData.title: Compounding Positions: Fortune Through Risk—or a Fast Track to Liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Compounding positions has been all the rage lately, and the stories are always the same: use a small amount of capital with several times leverage to ride a major trend, compound a few times,
and turn it into dozens of times your original investment. Today, let’s talk about what they don’t tell you.

【What Does Compounding Positions Mean?】Instead of cashing out unrealized profits, you use them as risk capital for new positions and keep trading,
It’s essentially using the market’s money to increase your leverage. As long as the trend continues, compounding can be astonishing; when the trend stops, floating profits can go
from gains of several dozen points to zero in just one or two massive down candles.

【The Mathematical Truth】The essence of compounding positions is “getting it right consecutively.” If your win rate is 60% each time, the odds of getting it right four times in a row
are only 13%. Those posts you see about doubling your money overnight are backed by 99 people who’ve already deleted their accounts.

一、以太坊市场深度分析：一千八百美元关口攻防战，聪明钱逆势布局

二〇二六年十一月十七日，以太坊报价一千八百零一美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点六。价格在经历一千七百七十八美元的低点后快速反弹，最高触及一千八百一十八美元。当前以太坊正处于关键支撑位保卫战，ETF资金持续流出与聪明钱逆势买入形成鲜明对比。

二、技术指标全面解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报一千七百九十二美元，二十五小时均线报一千八百一十四美元，九十九小时均线报一千八百三十二美元。价格刚刚站上七日均线，但仍低于中长期均线，短期有企稳迹象但中期压力明显。七日均线开始拐头向上，若能持续上行并与二十五日均线形成金叉，将确认短期趋势反转。

布林带指标显示，上轨一千八百四十八美元，中轨一千八百一十二美元，下轨一千七百七十五美元。价格从下轨附近强势反弹至中轨上方，表明短期买盘力量较强。布林带带宽较大，市场波动性仍然偏高，需要关注价格能否在中轨上方站稳。

MACD指标方面，快线负六点二二，慢线负五点四九，柱状图负零点七三。MACD虽然仍在零轴下方，但柱状图已连续收窄，空头力量明显减弱。快线有上穿慢线的趋势，一旦形成金叉将进一步确认反弹行情。

RSI六周期从三十六点四五快速攀升至六十点九四，突破五十中轴进入偏多区域。KDJ指标中K值五十九点六二，D值五十二点三十一，J值七十四点二四，三线同步上行且J值领先，显示短期动能充沛。威廉指标从负六十改善至负二十四，同样确认多头力量占优。

量化因子方面，十五个因子中六个发出做多信号，八个做空信号，一个中性。复合指标值为零点二二，整体给出做多信号，历史胜率高达百分之八十二点三五。值得注意的是，做空信号的历史胜率也达到百分之九十二点三一，说明当前市场信号切换频繁，需要密切关注方向确认。

Stablecoin supply contracts｜Ethereum on-chain balances fall in tandem｜Wait for funds to return before betting on ETH

My stance is cautious: I’m not yet treating ETH’s short-term rebound as evidence that fresh capital has returned. Binance Square is discussing #StablecoinMarketShrinksAtFastestPaceSinceTerraLuna. This topic is relevant to ETH because stablecoins are important settlement assets for on-chain trading, lending, and payments, but a “decline in supply” does not mean the Ethereum network is malfunctioning. I checked DeFiLlama’s publicly available daily data directly. Using its measure of the circulating supply of USD-pegged stablecoins, denominated in dollars, the total across all chains was about $302.5 billion on October 18 and about $286.5 billion on November 17—a decline of about $16.1 billion over 30 days. On Ethereum, it fell from about $144.3 billion to about $132.0 billion, a decrease of about $12.2 billion. These figures are based on the website’s current snapshot and may be revised later; the claim “fastest since Terra” should not be taken as a conclusion from a historical ranking I independently completed.

These figures show that the available dollar balance in the trading ecosystem is shrinking, but they do not prove that every dollar has left the crypto market: redemptions, cross-chain migration, changes in issuance composition, price movements, and differences in measurement methodology may all have an impact. The decline on Ethereum accounts for more than half of the net decrease across all chains, which also suggests that funds may be shifting between chains; balances alone cannot tell us whether holders are buying ETH, converting to fiat, or moving stablecoins to another chain. Circle’s recently disclosed USDC circulation and reserve information can provide a cross-check at the issuer level, but the dates differ from DeFiLlama’s November 17 snapshot, so the two figures cannot be directly subtracted to calculate redemptions on that day.

For ETH, what concerns me more is whether spot buying and DeFi collateral capacity weaken together as on-chain dollar liquidity declines. ETH would have firmer support if stablecoin balances stabilize and on-chain transaction demand recovers; if balances keep shrinking, a rally supported solely by a particular fund or a product announcement would be fragile. Market prices also haven’t signaled a clear reversal: I checked Binance ETH/USDT at around $1,798, down about 1.16% over the rolling 24 hours, with a low of $1,751.39 and a high of $1,843.49. According to Farside, U.S. ETH funds saw combined net outflows of about $8.4 million through November 16. The November 17 entry has not yet been fully updated, so a blank field should not be counted as a new outflow. $1,751 is a near-term risk level, while $1,844 is the upper level that needs to be reclaimed; these are trading reference points, not valuation conclusions.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now and consider only a small spot long after confirmation, with a maximum position size of 3% of account capital and no leverage. The trigger would be ETH/USDT closing above $1,845 on the four-hour chart, holding above $1,835 on a retest, and the next stablecoin data release no longer showing a rapid decline. If it only briefly breaks above the level, I would remain in cash. After entry, the first target would be $1,885, where I would take half off; the second target would be $1,930. I would set the initial stop-loss at $1,805, and close the remaining position if the four-hour candle closes back below $1,835. If price breaks below $1,751 first, I would cancel the plan outright and wait for fresh confirmation from fund flows and price action. I would first cross-check issuer disclosures against on-chain balances, then decide whether to adjust my view.

稳定币供给收缩｜以太坊链上余额同步下降｜ETH先等资金回流

我的态度是偏谨慎，暂不把ETH的短线反弹当成增量资金回来了。币安广场正在讨论#StablecoinMarketShrinksAtFastestPaceSinceTerraLuna；这个话题与ETH相关，因为稳定币是链上交易、借贷和支付的重要结算资产，但“供给下降”不等于以太坊网络出故障。我直接查了DeFiLlama公开日序列，按其美元锚定稳定币的美元计价流通量口径，10月18日全链约3025亿美元，11月17日约2865亿美元，30天减少约161亿美元；其中以太坊链约从1443亿美元降至1320亿美元，减少约122亿美元。数据是网站当前快照，后续可能修订，不应把“最快自Terra以来”当成我已独立完成全历史排序的结论。

这组数字说明交易生态里的可用美元余额收缩，却不能证明每一美元都流出加密市场：赎回、跨链迁移、发行结构调整、价格与统计口径变化都可能产生影响。以太坊链上的减少量大于全链净减少量的一半，也提示资金可能在链之间重新分布；仅凭余额无法识别持币人是在买ETH、兑换法币还是把稳定币转去别的链。Circle官网最近披露的USDC流通量及储备信息，可为发行人层面提供交叉参照，但日期与DeFiLlama的11月17日快照不同，不能把两者直接相减得出当日赎回额。

传导到ETH，我更关心的是链上美元资金减少时，现货买盘和DeFi抵押能力是否一起变弱。若稳定币余额止跌、链上交易需求回升，ETH才有更扎实的支撑；若继续收缩，单靠某只基金或一条产品公告撑起上涨会比较脆弱。市场价格目前也没有给出明确反转：我查看币安ETH/USDT约1798美元，滚动24小时跌约1.16%，低点1751.39、高点1843.49美元。Farside截至11月16日美国ETH基金合计约净流出840万美元，11月17日一栏仍未完整更新，不能把空栏算作新的资金流出。1751是近端风险线，1844是需要收复的上沿；这两个价格是交易观察位，不是估值结论。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向只考虑确认后的现货小仓做多，最大仓位为账户资金的3%，不加杠杆。触发条件是ETH/USDT四小时收在1845美元上方，回踩1835不破，同时下一次稳定币数据不再继续快速下降；若只是瞬时上穿，继续空仓。触发后第一目标1885美元，先减半，第二目标1930美元；初始止损设在1805美元，四小时重新收回1835下方则剩余部分平仓。若先跌破1751美元，直接撤销计划，等待新的资金和价格确认。我会优先核对发行人披露与链上余额，再决定是否调整判断。

【原则】每次加仓的量比上一次少。比如首仓30%，第一次回调确认加20%，
再确认加10%。越往上仓位越轻，成本的重心压在低位，回调时你扛得住。

【反过来为什么危险】倒金字塔（底部轻仓、顶部越加越重）意味着你的
平均成本全在高位，稍微一回撤就由赚转亏，心态一崩，操作全变形。
很多人不是看错方向亏的钱，是加仓加错了顺序亏的钱。

【三条铁规矩】1. 只在盈利的单上加仓，亏损的单只减不加（不摊平！）；
2. 每加一次，整体止损位同步上移；3. 加仓前问自己：如果这是全新的一
笔钱，我现在还愿意在这个价位开仓吗？答案犹豫，就别加。

translatedData.title: Pyramiding: How to Add to a Winning Trend Trade Without Blowing Up
translatedData.subTitle:
If you’ve got the trend right and want to add to your position, how should you do it? Going all in right away and adding to the max with unrealized profits is a surefire way to end up on the liquidation list.
A common mistake. The right approach is called pyramiding.

【Principle】Add less each time than you did the time before. For example, start with 30%, then add 20% after the first pullback is confirmed,
After confirmation, add another 10%. The higher the price goes, the smaller your position should be, keeping most of your cost basis low so you can withstand a pullback.

【Why the opposite is dangerous】An inverted pyramid (a small position at the bottom, adding more and more as the price rises) means your
average cost is concentrated at the top. Even a slight pullback can turn profits into losses; once you lose your nerve, every trade goes off the rails.

The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is investigating whether Nvidia may have misled investors, which could result in hefty fines or even private lawsuits. This is about more than regulators scrutinizing a single tech giant; at its core, it reflects growing market fears of an AI bubble. Over the past year, AI stocks have been bid up to sky-high prices, but signs of fatigue are emerging as earnings season gets underway. Nvidia’s earnings growth is slowing, and news that Qualcomm was fined $12.5 billion has investors starting to worry about valuation traps. Nvidia’s problem is that orders for its GPU chips have declined for the first time, and the regulatory investigation has struck right at this vulnerability. This means institutions are beginning to reassess how tech stocks are valued, shifting from “unlimited trust” to “cautious scrutiny.”

The direct impact on BTC and ETH is limited, but the possible knock-on effects warrant attention. If Nvidia pays a massive fine or loses in court, it could trigger a broad sell-off in tech stocks. South Korea is one of the world’s most active crypto trading markets, and local investors are highly sensitive to tech stocks. A deeper impact is that institutional investors may pull out of highly valued tech stocks and move into undervalued assets, directly supporting BTC prices. title: 2%仓位法则：为什么亏得起才能活得久
subTitle:
今天讲一个被讲烂了但99%的人做不到的规矩：单笔交易的最大亏损，
不要超过总资金的2%。

【算笔账】1万U本金，2%就是单笔最多亏200U。连续错10次，还剩八千，
账户只回撤20%，靠几笔对的单就能回来。反过来，每次梭哈亏30%，
连错三次只剩34%，要翻近2倍才能回本——数学上已经基本判死刑了。

【怎么落地】不是「仓位不超过2%」，是「这笔单打到止损位时亏的钱
不超过2%」。所以正确顺序是：找止损位 → 算止损距离 → 反推仓位。
止损远的单仓位小，止损近的单仓位可以适当放大。

【为什么难】因为2%赚得太慢，人性嫌它不够刺激。但市场淘汰的从来
不是赚得慢的人，是亏得快的人。先做到不爆仓，再谈翻倍。

translatedData.title: The 2% Position Sizing Rule: Why You Need to Be Able to Take Losses to Survive in the Long Run
translatedData.subTitle:
Today, let’s talk about a rule that’s been repeated to death but that 99% of people can’t follow: the maximum loss on a single trade
should not exceed 2% of your total capital.

【Let’s do the math】With 10,000 U in starting capital, 2% means losing no more than 200 U on a single trade. After 10 consecutive losses, you’d still have 8,000,
If your account only draws down 20%, a few winning trades can bring it back. By contrast, if you go all in and lose 30% each time,
after three losses in a row, you’re left with just 34%—you’d need to nearly triple your money to break even. Mathematically, you’re practically finished.

【How to put it into practice】It’s not “keep your position size under 2%”; it’s “make sure the amount you lose if this trade hits its stop-loss
doesn’t exceed 2%.” So the right order is: find the stop-loss level → calculate the stop-loss distance → work backward to determine the position size.

title: 分批止盈：落袋为安和让利润奔跑，怎么兼得
subTitle:
止盈比止损难，因为止损砍的是恐惧，止盈砍的是贪婪。行情越好你越不想
卖，一回调又后悔没跑。分享我一直在用的分批止盈。

【三段式】第一段：到第一个目标位（比如1倍盈亏比）减仓1/3，先落袋，
这时候这笔单已经不会亏了，心态立刻不一样。第二段：到第二目标位
（比如2倍盈亏比）再减1/3。第三段：剩下的用移动止损跟，跌破均线
或前低就走，让利润自己跑。

【为什么这样】全仓跑早了会拍大腿，全仓拿着经常坐电梯回到解放前。
分批的本质是把「卖在最高点」这个不可能任务，拆成三笔还不错的决策。

【关键动作】减仓之后把止损上移到成本价，这就是传说中的「免费单」。
手里的利润单，最怕的就是抱着抱着变成亏损单。

translatedData.title: Scale out of profits: How to lock in gains while letting profits run
translatedData.subTitle:
Taking profits is harder than stopping out, because a stop-loss means cutting through fear, while taking profits means curbing greed. The better the market is doing, the less you want to
sell—and then when it pulls back, you regret not getting out. Here's the scale-out profit-taking approach I've been using.

【Three stages】First stage: when it reaches the first target (e.g. a 1:1 risk/reward ratio), reduce your position by 1/3 and lock in some profits first,
At this point, the trade can no longer lose money, and your mindset immediately changes. Second stage: when it reaches the second target
(e.g. a 2:1 risk/reward ratio), sell another 1/3. Third stage: trail the rest with a moving stop-loss, and exit if it falls below the moving average
or the previous low. Let the profits run.

【Why this works】Exit the whole position too early and you'll kick yourself; hold the whole position and you often ride the elevator right back to where you started.

以太坊市场深度分析：ETF资金外流加剧，但聪明钱正在低位布局

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十七日晚间，以太坊现货价格报一千七百八十九美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点八。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个交易小时内经历了一波先跌后稳的走势，从一千七百八十五美元开盘，最低下探至一千七百六十七美元，随后逐步回升至一千七百九十四美元附近。最近一个小时的成交量仅为六百七十一枚ETH，折合一百二十万美元，相比前一小时的八千五百零二枚大幅萎缩，表明在经历快速下杀后市场暂时进入平衡状态。

以太坊近期的下跌受到多重因素打压。首先，历史交易所被黑钱包转移了超过三万四千枚ETH，这些来路不明的资金引发了市场的恐慌性抛售，每小时净流出超过三千二百万美元。其次，以太坊现货ETF在过去一周累计流出三亿九千九百万美元，机构资金的持续撤离给价格带来了沉重压力。价格已经跌破了关键的一千八百美元心理关口，技术形态进一步恶化。不过值得注意的是，尽管ETF资金在流出，但分析师报告指出聪明钱正在低位积累看多的ETH仓位，这种分歧值得关注。

二、技术指标解读

以太坊的技术指标呈现出与比特币不同的信号特征。六周期RSI为四十三点五一，十二周期RSI为四十三点四三，二十四周期RSI为四十五点零一，虽然处于偏弱区域但已经从此前的超卖状态中回升。KDJ指标显示K值为四十八点七五，D值为四十七点七六，J值为五十点七二，三线粘合且位于中性区域，暗示短期方向尚不明朗。

title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where Should You Place a Stop-Loss? How I Choose Between Technical Levels and Percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Place it too close and you’ll get stopped out every day; too far and one loss can really hurt.

【Fixed Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. It’s simple and straightforward, and suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop could end up right where other people’s stops are clustered.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the market structure becomes invalid: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, it’s evidence that I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop-loss distance is large, reduce your position size to keep the loss on any single trade within a certain percentage of your capital.

ETH Staking Fund Discloses Holdings | 337,045 ETH Was the Quarter-End Balance | Wait for Confirmation Near 1,792

I remain cautious and on the sidelines, especially when it comes to interpreting institutional staking figures as evidence of new buying today. BlackRock’s iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHB) recently filed its third-quarter report with the U.S. SEC. It states that, as of September 30, the fund had 337,045 ETH staked through third parties, representing 76.4% of its holdings at the time. This is a quarter-end snapshot; it should not be described as a purchase or staking commitment made just now, on November 17. The iShares website also clearly states that the product tracks both the price of ETH and some staking rewards. The fund’s report explains that the trust retains control of its ETH during staking, and delegating to validators does not mean selling the coins to them. For the market, the key point is that institutions’ approach to holding ETH is expanding from pure price exposure to price exposure plus on-chain yield. But a high staking ratio also makes liquidity management during creations and redemptions worth watching more closely.

I pay closer attention to the difference between “yield” and “tradability.” The report says that, after fees, staking rewards are intended to be distributed in U.S. dollars monthly, and at least quarterly. This is not a guaranteed return on the price of ETH, nor does it mean that people holding fund shares receive an equivalent amount of ETH. The fund also needs to keep liquid assets available for redemptions. If demand suddenly rises, the time needed to unstake, as well as service-provider and custody arrangements, could all affect execution. So treating 337,045 ETH as permanently locked supply would overstate the support for spot prices. Meanwhile, Farside reported net outflows of $8.4 million from U.S. spot ETH funds on November 16, while the November 17 column is still blank. The 0.0 currently shown on the page simply means the data is incomplete; it is not proof of zero outflows or inflows.

The market reaction also does not support the claim that “institutional staking data immediately sends prices higher.” When I checked ETH/USDT on Binance, the price was around $1,792, down about 1.19% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,751 to $1,843. The price was also below yesterday’s opening level of around $1,813, showing that the sizable historical staking balance in the quarterly report has not changed the selling pressure at this moment. $1,751 is the short-term low; a decisive break below it would further weaken the structure. $1,813, near the 24-hour opening level, is the first recovery level, while $1,843 is the 24-hour high. I would only shift from a defensive stance to cautiously bullish if the price recovers $1,843 and fund-flow data improve at the same time. If the price rises and then falls back below $1,813, that would invalidate the recovery thesis. Institutional infrastructure development is worth following over the long term, but it cannot replace current price action and creation-and-redemption signals.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. My only planned direction is a spot long after confirmation, with a maximum position size of 4% of total capital and no leverage. The entry trigger is a four-hour candle close above $1,843, followed by a retest in the $1,813–$1,843 range that holds, along with at least one full trading day of fund data showing no further increase in outflows. If even one condition is missing, I would not place a trade. The first target is $1,880, where I would sell half; the second target is $1,920, where I would reduce the remaining position. I would set the initial stop below $1,810 and close the position outright if a four-hour candle closes back below $1,813 after entry. If the price breaks below $1,751 first, I would cancel the long plan and would not add to the position just because “institutions are staking.” If macroeconomic or fund data change sharply during the session, I would reduce risk first and reassess; I would not let a long-term narrative overshadow immediate losses.

#ETH

我的态度仍是谨慎观望，尤其不把机构质押规模直接翻译成今天有新买盘。贝莱德旗下iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF（ETHB）近期提交给美国SEC的三季报写明：截至9月30日，基金有337045枚ETH通过第三方参与质押，占当时持仓的76.4%。这是一份季末快照，不能说成11月17日刚买入或刚锁仓。iShares官网也明确该产品同时追踪ETH价格与部分质押收益；基金报告说明质押期间信托仍保有ETH控制权，委托验证不等于把币卖给验证者。对于市场，重要的是机构持有ETH的方式正在从单纯价格敞口扩展为价格加链上收益，但质押比例高也意味着申赎时的流动性管理更值得观察。

我更关注“收益”和“可交易性”之间的差别。报告称，质押奖励扣除费用后计划按月、至少按季以美元分配；这不是ETH价格的保底收益，也不意味着持有基金份额的人获得同等数量的ETH。基金还需为赎回保留可用资产，一旦需求突然上升，质押解除的时间、服务商与托管安排都可能影响执行。因此把337045枚简单视为永久锁死的流通量，会高估对现货的支撑。另一边，Farside的11月16日美国现货ETH基金净流出840万美元，而11月17日栏位目前仍是横线；页面暂列0.0只是数据未齐，不是零流出或零流入的证明。

市场反应也没有支持“机构质押数据一出就拉盘”的说法。我查询币安ETH/USDT时约1792美元，24小时跌约1.19%，区间1751至1843。价格比昨日开盘约1813还低，说明季报里较大的历史质押存量，并未改变此刻的卖压。1751是短线低点，若被有效跌破，结构会进一步转弱；1813是当期24小时开盘附近的第一道修复位，1843是近24小时高点。只有价格收回1843且资金数据同步改善，我才把当前走势由防守改为试探性偏多；若冲高后重新失守1813，就推翻修复判断。机构基础设施的长期建设值得跟踪，但不能代替当下的价格和申赎信号。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，方向仅预设为确认后的现货做多，仓位最多占总资金4%，不用杠杆。入场触发是四小时K线收在1843上方，随后回踩1813至1843区间能守住，并看到至少一个完整交易日的基金数据不再扩大流出；少一个条件都不下单。第一目标看1880，到位减半；第二目标看1920，再减剩余仓位。初始止损设在1810下方，若入场后四小时收盘跌回1813以下则直接平仓；若先跌破1751，撤销做多计划，不因“机构在质押”而补仓。若宏观或基金数据在盘中突变，先降低风险再重新评估，不能让远期叙事覆盖眼前损失。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本
影响你这笔交易的性价比。

translatedData.title: What Is the Funding Rate? Why Do Longs Have to Pay Shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is a payment between longs and shorts
that they pay each other. The exchange only collects and transfers the money; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how do their prices stay in line with spot prices? That’s where the funding rate comes in:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (bears have the upper hand) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
The money flows back and forth between both sides, pulling the contract price toward the spot price.

translatedData.content:
ETH｜Glamsterdam audit reaches decision eve｜Mainnet date unset; manage risk first

My view is to wait for the test results and not treat upgrade expectations as an immediate positive catalyst. In its November 6 article, the Ethereum Foundation explicitly said that EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 change the way gas is charged for some state operations. Testing found that several deployed projects rely on existing invariants, which could lead to compatibility issues after the upgrade. As a result, the Hoodi testnet hard fork was postponed while the issues are clarified. In a November 9 update, the Foundation said it had received four reports concerning deployed contracts and scheduled a developer testing meeting for November 16 to discuss audit findings publicly. The November 19 execution-layer meeting will then discuss possible specification changes, with no outcome predetermined. The agenda for the official Ethereum developer meeting also lists independent audits by ChainSecurity and Dedaub, as well as feedback from application teams. The official Glamsterdam overview still has no mainnet activation date.

This does not mean “ETH mainnet has been attacked,” nor that “the upgrade has been canceled.” What really matters is whether changes to the cost of state writes can be implemented without breaking existing application assumptions. If the audit finds the scope is limited, and testing goes smoothly after the specification is revised, development certainty will improve, and long-term ecosystem expectations may be repriced. If major changes are needed or the upgrade is delayed further, the time value of the short-term narrative will decline. For traders, a delay for a security audit is usually more important than an unverified upgrade date, because once an incident reaches mainnet, it is difficult to undo. Distinguish findings from decisions, and don’t treat Thursday’s meeting as a vote that has already passed.

The market has not yet shown strong confirmation. When I checked ETHUSDT on Binance, the price was around $1,787, down about 1.69% over the past 24 hours, with a range of $1,751 to $1,843. The Farside page showed net outflows of about $8.4 million from spot ETH funds on November 16. The entries for all funds on November 17 were still blank, so the page’s total of 0 should not be interpreted as actual zero flows for that day. The price remains in the lower half of its range, suggesting the audit process has yet to offset current risk-aversion pressures. I view $1,844 as the threshold for a short-term strengthening, and $1,751 as support. A break below $1,751 followed by a sustained failure to reclaim it would invalidate the rebound outlook.

If I were trading this myself, I would sit out for now and only consider a small spot position to go long. The entry trigger would be ETH moving above $1,844 and holding above $1,835 on a retest, while the official November 19 meeting confirms a viable testing path. I would use only 4% of my total capital for the initial position and avoid adding high leverage. The first target is $1,885, followed by $1,930. I would sell half at $1,885 and use a trailing stop for the remainder, with an initial stop-loss at $1,795. If the meeting further delays key testing, the price falls back below $1,835, or the stop-loss is hit, I would close the entire position. If these conditions don’t occur, I’ll stay flat and wait for facts rather than anticipate the outcome.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH｜Glamsterdam审计进入决策前夜｜主网未定日期先管风险

我的态度是先看测试结论，不把升级预期当成立即利好。以太坊基金会11月6日文章明确说，EIP-8037和8038改变部分状态操作的Gas计费方式，测试中发现若干已部署项目依赖旧有不变量，升级后可能出现兼容问题，因此决定暂缓Hoodi测试网硬分叉，等待问题厘清。基金会在11月9日更新称收到四份关于已部署合约的报告，并安排11月16日的开发者测试会议公开讨论审计发现，11月19日执行层会议再讨论可能的规范调整，且没有预设结果。Ethereum官方开发会议议程也列出ChainSecurity、Dedaub的独立审计和应用团队反馈。当前官方Glamsterdam总览仍未填写主网激活时间。

这不是“ETH主网已经遭攻击”，也不是“升级已经取消”。真正值得盯的是状态写入成本变化能否在不破坏现有应用假设的前提下落地。若审计指出范围有限、修正规范后测试顺利，开发确定性会改善，长期生态预期才可能重新定价；若需要大幅调整或继续推迟，短期叙事的时间价值会下降。对交易者而言，安全审计延迟通常比未经验证的升级日期更重要，因为事故风险一旦进入主网就很难回头。先把发现和决定区分开，别把周四会议当成已经通过的投票。

市场目前没有提前给出强势确认。我查询币安ETHUSDT时，价格约1787美元，近24小时跌约1.69%，区间1751至1843美元。Farside页面显示11月16日现货ETH基金净流出约840万美元，11月17日各基金仍是空栏，不能把页面合计的0解释为当天真实零流量。价格仍在区间下半部，说明审计进程尚不足以抵消眼前风险偏好压力。我将1844视为短线转强门槛，1751视为防线；若跌破1751并持续无法收回，就推翻反弹判断。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向只考虑现货小仓位试多。入场触发是ETH站上1844美元并回踩守住1835，同时11月19日官方会议确认可执行的测试路径；只用总资金4%建首仓，不加高杠杆。目标先看1885，再看1930，到1885减半，余仓用移动止盈；初始止损设在1795。若会议继续推迟关键测试、价格重新跌回1835下方，或触及止损，我全部平仓。若条件没出现，我保持空仓，等待事实而不是预支结论。

#ETH

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant—it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

【Step 1】Initial margin: The funds tied up when you open a position. For example, with 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
【Step 2】The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts showing “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add margin.
【Step 3】Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system starts partially liquidating your position,
closing part of the position first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures contract, you'll be asked to choose “isolated margin” or “cross margin.” Many beginners pick one without thinking and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross Margin】All the balance in your account is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Disadvantage: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's putting all your eggs in one
The eggs in the basket support one another.

【Isolated Margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the losses won't spread to your other positions or principal. The risk is kept in a cage.

【My recommendation】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you don't yet have the ability to assess the worst-case scenario for a single bad trade

$PROM: When High Relative Volume Misleads: A Liquidity Thought Experiment

Why does $PROM show an hourly down candle even though volume is above its baseline? The recorded observation places price inside the local range, the hourly direction is down, and relative volume is 2.13x baseline.

**Myth**: A spike in relative volume automatically means market participants are pushing price higher. Many assume the surge confirms bullish pressure and that the session will break out.

**Explanation**: Volume alone measures how much trading occurred, not the balance of buying versus selling. In a down‑trend candle, the excess trades can be dominated by sellers who are closing positions or taking profit, which raises the volume count without changing direction. The price staying within the recorded range suggests that the market absorbed the activity without a decisive move. Thus, the same relative‑volume figure can represent either aggressive buying in an up candle or aggressive selling in a down candle.

**Limits**: This reasoning relies only on the single‑session snapshot. It does not account for hidden order flow, order‑book depth, or broader timeframe trends. A future closed‑candle showing a sustained upward move with continued high relative volume would weaken the current interpretation, indicating that the volume was indeed supportive of a breakout.

**Reassessment cue**: Watch for the next hourly candle; if price reverses up while relative volume remains elevated, the earlier high volume likely reflected latent buying pressure rather than pure selling.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

A useful cross-check: $ETH has hourly direction up and volume not above its baseline; $HOME has hourly direction up and volume not above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

Just said Bitcoin ETF holdings were increasing, and now Susquehanna has poured in another $300 million

Susquehanna increased its Bitcoin ETF holdings to $622 million in the third quarter, showing that money really is flowing into mainstream funds.

Just the other day, I mentioned that Cantor Fitzgerald’s increased holdings in crypto strategy stocks had made the market nervous. Now Susquehanna has tripled its ETF holdings to $622 million. This is a long-established Wall Street investment bank, and it’s not just jumping on the bandwagon this time—the filing calls it a “strategic decision,” meaning it genuinely sees long-term potential. The $622 million comes from Susquehanna Global Strategies’ FSPX ETF, the Wells Fargo spot Bitcoin ETF. This move pushed FSPX ETF’s total assets to the second-largest in the industry, behind only BlackRock. Put simply, it’s telling the market with real money: crypto investing isn’t a short-term fad; it’s a legitimate sector.

Impact on the market
- Short term: This money didn’t come out of nowhere; Susquehanna raised it from clients. It means institutions are buying in batches, directly supporting BTC prices and keeping them from falling too quickly. A look at the charts shows that BTC often performs best on days when FSPX ETF trading volume surges and its price rises.
- Medium term: This move could bring more money into the market. At present, the U.S. is the only country that allows spot Bitcoin ETFs; other countries, such as South Korea and Australia, are still watching. Susquehanna’s move could bolster the case for easing U.S. regulations, for example by allowing Bitcoin futures ETFs.

My take
I’m 70% confident in this view; I’ll leave the remaining 30% to the market. Susquehanna isn’t alone—Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan are also building teams and developing crypto businesses. As long as ETFs stick around, resistance above BTC will keep rising. That said, when the dollar strengthens, commodities tend to suffer, and Bitcoin can’t withstand a prolonged run of rate hikes either. Take it easy if I’m wrong—I’m only testing the waters with a small position myself.

$BTC $ETH #BTC #ETH

⚠️ This is not investment advice

Why did I just say Solana could still come out on top amid the crypto market crash, and now Mitsui is lining up a major deal for it?

I talked about this just a couple of days ago, and now there’s a new development. Japanese giant Mitsui & Co. (Mitsui) has suddenly announced plans to use Solana to upgrade its commodity tokenization efforts, explicitly citing efficiency as the key reason.

In a nutshell: Mitsui choosing Solana for commodity tokenization shows that institutional confidence in Solana has grown even stronger.

What’s going on? Global Fortune 500 company Mitsui, a veteran in supply chain finance, has decided to use Solana blockchain technology to digitize hard assets such as oil and metals. Why did they choose Solana? The original report cited “efficiency”—in plain terms, Solana is fast and has low transaction fees, making it suitable for commercial use cases like high-frequency trading. Compared with established public blockchains like Ethereum, Solana does have advantages in cost and performance. That’s also why institutions are increasingly optimistic about it.

Market impact:
- In the short term, this gives Solana a direct boost, and the positive sentiment could build for a few days. A major move like this by Mitsui is bound to attract other traditional finance players to follow suit.
- In the medium term, this is a classic example of a public blockchain moving from concept to large-scale commercial use. It accelerates the process of bringing real-world assets on-chain and is a boost for the entire DeFi industry.

My view: SOL’s uptrend remains intact, with $72 as an important support level. But whether it can reach $100 will depend on whether market sentiment gets another catalyst. Institutional approval is one factor, but if the broader trends for Bitcoin and ETH don’t pick up, smaller coins will struggle to rally on their own.

为什么刚说 Solana 在币崩中还能笑到最后，现在 Mitsui 又要给它送大单了？

前两天刚说过这件事，现在有了新进展。日本巨头三井物产（Mitsui）突然宣布要用 Solana 升级商品通证化，直接点名效率是关键原因。

一句话说清楚：三井物产选 Solana 做商品通证，说明机构对 Solana 的信任又加码了。

怎么回事？就是三井物产这个全球500强大佬，搞供应链金融的老手，决定用 Solana 区块链技术给石油、金属这些硬通货做数字化。他们为啥选 Solana？新闻原文说的是"效率"，说白了就是 Solana 链速度快、手续费低，适合高频交易这些商业场景。对比以太坊那种老牌公链，Solana 在成本和性能上确实有优势，这也是为什么机构越来越看好的原因。

对市场的影响：
- 短期看，直接给 Solana 加了强心针，利好情绪会发酵几天。Mitsui 这么大手笔，肯定会吸引其他传统金融玩家跟风。
- 中期来看，这是公链从概念走向大规模商业应用的典型案例，加速了现实世界资产上链进程，对整个DeFi行业都是提振。

我的判断：SOL 这波上涨趋势没变，72美元是重要防守位。但要说能冲上100美元，那还看市场情绪有没有进一步催化剂。机构客户的认可是一方面，但比特币和ETH这种大方向没起色，小币种很难单飞。

🚨 ETHEREUM NEWS | Glamsterdam Upgrade Could Break 15,000 Apps ⚠️

Ethereum's next big upgrade, Glamsterdam, may
disrupt up to 15,000 automated programs. 😱
Core developers will reconsider the changes this Thursday.

📌 WHAT HAPPENED
🔸 Ethereum Foundation developer Marius van der Wijden
   shared the estimate on a developer call
🔸 Up to 15,000 smart contracts could be affected
🔸 That is a tiny share of ~90 million contracts on Ethereum
🔸 Estimated money at risk: a few hundred thousand dollars
🔸 Independent audits have found hundreds of
   separate compatibility problems

⛽ WHAT IS CHANGING? (EIP-8037 & EIP-8038)

The upgrade changes how Ethereum charges gas
for creating and storing data.

🔸 Deploying a new contract: 32,000 → ~183,600 gas
🔸 Creating a new storage slot: 20,000 → ~97,920 gas

🎯 WHY DO IT?
To stop Ethereum's database from growing too fast
as more activity is packed into each block.

💥 WHY APPS CAN BREAK
Many apps were built assuming gas costs stay fixed,
or send a fixed gas allowance when calling other
contracts. Higher costs can make those calls fail.

🧪 WHAT'S BEING DONE
The Ethereum Foundation hired outside security firms
to stress test which major apps would break.
Testing of the proposed changes has already been delayed.

💡 WHY IT MATTERS
Upgrades are about making Ethereum scalable, but
they must not break what is already built.
Watch Thursday's developer decision. 👀

Not financial advice. Educational purposes only.

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

The saga of persistent outflows from Bitcoin ETFs has finally come to a temporary halt. It’s like a marathon runner suddenly stopping to catch their breath—not knowing whether they’ve recovered their strength or something even more frightening lies ahead. For ordinary investors, this brief pause is temporarily good news, but whether the run can continue depends on whether it rains later. Those betting that ETFs would bring a steady stream of buy orders are probably feeling conflicted right now.

Why does this news matter?

The pause in ETF outflows reflects a tug-of-war between two market forces. On the one hand, the persistent withdrawals have weighed heavily on BTC, making it difficult for the price to rise. On the other hand, this sudden pause could mean that some savvy investors are watching for something—perhaps the end of the Fed’s rate hikes, or institutions quietly positioning themselves. A deeper reason may be that the money that fled ETFs hasn’t disappeared; it’s just lying low for now, ready to flow back in somewhere safer. This doesn’t contradict institutions’ continued interest in the digital asset industry over the past few months; it just means the money is entering the market more discreetly.

Market impact

In the short term, the halt in ETF outflows has at least given the market some breathing room, helping BTC find support around $63,961.34. But it’s too early to say that it will now soar. More importantly, the global macro environment remains highly uncertain—Federal Reserve rate decisions and geopolitical risks will continue to affect investors’ risk appetite. If regulators really decide to crack down on cryptocurrencies, these ETF inflows and outflows will be the least of our concerns. Historically, a similar situation occurred in 2018, when ETF outflows eventually triggered a further market plunge. So it’s too soon to say BTC can hold at $64,800.

Trading outlook

For now, BTC has encountered temporary resistance at $64,800. But given that the halt in ETF outflows is a positive signal, this level may be worth watching closely. If ETFs continue to see inflows, this resistance could be broken. But keep in mind that if the macro environment worsens—for example, if the Fed suddenly announces another rate hike—this outlook will no longer hold.

📰 ETF大逃亡暂停了？为什么BTC在$64,800前突然刹住车？

ETF资金持续撤离比特币的闹剧终于暂时告一段落。这就像是马拉松选手跑着跑着突然停下喘气，不知道是体力恢复了，还是前方有更可怕的东西等着他。对普通投资者来说，这短暂的停顿是暂时的好消息，但能不能持续跑下去，还得看后面会不会下雨。特别是那些押注ETF能带来源源不断买单的人，现在心里估计挺矛盾的。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这个ETF资金流出停止的现象背后，其实反映了市场两种力量的拉锯。一方面，持续的资金撤离确实给BTC套上了沉重的枷锁，让价格想涨都涨不起来。另一方面，这种突然的停顿也意味着，可能有些聪明钱在观察着什么——或许是美联储加息的终点，或许是机构资金正在悄悄布局。更深层的原因可能是，那些逃离ETF的钱并没有消失，只是暂时藏起来了，随时准备在某个更安全的地方重新涌回来。这与近几个月机构对数字资产行业的持续兴趣并不矛盾，只是资金入场的方式更加隐蔽。

对市场的影响
从短期看，ETF停止资金流出至少给了市场一点喘息的空间，让BTC价格从$63,961.34附近获得支撑。但要说能就此一飞冲天，目前还太早。更关键的是，全球宏观环境依然充满不确定性——美联储的利率决策、地缘政治风险，这些因素都会持续影响投资者的风险偏好。如果监管层真的要拿加密货币开刀，那么ETF这点资金流入流出根本不够看。历史来看，类似的情况在2018年出现过，当时ETF资金流出最终引发了市场的进一步暴跌。所以，现在说BTC能稳住$64,800，为时尚早。

操作思路
目前看，BTC在$64,800这个位置形成了短暂的阻力，但考虑到ETF流出的停止是一个积极信号，这里或许值得密切关注。如果ETF后续能维持资金流入状态，那么这个阻力就有可能被突破。但要注意，如果宏观环境恶化，比如美联储突然宣布进一步加息，那么这个判断就作废了。

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 USDT control 1,000 USDT, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage is when the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 USDT in principal and use 10x leverage, you’re actually controlling a position worth
1,000 USDT. If the price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal. The reverse is true, too:
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note, the loss is calculated based on your total position, including borrowed funds.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. That’s called liquidation. It’s not
that you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact price level also depends on the margin ratio).

Technical principles | Why is Ethereum’s gas fee divided into a base fee and a tip?
The protocol automatically calculates the base fee based on the previous block’s usage. If usage is above the target, the fee goes up; if it’s below the target, the fee goes down.
With a base fee in place, wallets can estimate a reasonable fee directly based on on-chain conditions, so users don’t have to keep guessing how much to pay.
Under EIP-1559, the base fee paid for each Ethereum transaction is $ETH , and it is burned. Currently, 1779.58.
Knowledge can help you avoid some pitfalls, but it can’t replace position management.

title: Did Nvidia Margin Calls or the Anthropic IPO Crash Bitcoin? What the 1-Minute Tape Shows
subTitle:
Binance Square Preview
Did Nvidia Margin Calls or the Anthropic IPO Crash Bitcoin? What the 1-Minute Tape Shows

From Monday 9 Nov to Saturday night, $BTC dropped 14.3% ($74,824 → $64,130) and$ETH fell 16.8%. Two narratives dominated the timeline: forced selling from Nvidia margin calls after Jensen Huang's 12 Nov resignation, and investors liquidating crypto to fund Anthropic's 19 Nov IPO.

We timed both stories against 1-minute Binance perp data, open interest, taker flow, and Polymarket clocks:

Tech stocks rallied while crypto dumped: Over the same week, the QQQ perp gained +2.4%, AVGO +14.7%, and MU +12.1%, while VIX fell from 19.9 to 19.3. Only NVDA (−11.1%) and gold (−6.0%) fell alongside $BTC.
The crash happened while US markets were closed: $BTC actually gained +0.9 log points during US regular hours, losing −5.3 overnight and −5.8 on Saturday (−6.1% on $18.8B perp volume, 4.3× normal Saturday activity).
Nvidia caused only ~2 of BTC's 15 points: $BTC dropped −0.60% and −1.35% in the hours following NVDA's Wednesday after-hours drop (−8.3%) and Thursday pre-market shock (−5.8%), but returned to normal correlation (0.33) outside those windows.
No Binance liquidation cascade: $BTC open interest rose +3.5% on the week and stayed flat (−0.1%) during Saturday's −6.1% drop.
Anthropic IPO jumps left no footprint: Polymarket's "IPO on 19 Nov" surged from 0.20 to 0.92, yet the three largest market jumps were followed by completely ordinary $BTC hours (39th–85th percentile).

Macro rates (10Y yield 4.86% → 5.15%, DXY 101.65 → 103.41) fit the weekly direction, though 5-minute correlation with Treasury futures was 0.00. You don't need to guess the narrative to protect a book—you need 24/7 event-driven risk gates.

Tether invests in stablecoin payments｜Multichain expansion doesn’t mean buying ETH directly｜Only talk about a rebound if 1750 holds

My approach is to first look at real-world adoption and price support, and not chase ETH just because of a funding announcement. Binance Square is discussing #TetherCapitalMakesStrategicInvestmentInStables; Tether Capital’s official statement on November 17 confirmed a strategic investment in cross-border payments company Stables, aiming to expand USD₮ business payment infrastructure in Asia and the Middle East. Tether says Stables covers more than 160 markets, processes over $2 billion in USD₮ transactions annually, and connects local banks, payment systems, and stablecoin settlement through a single interface. Stables itself announced in May this year that it had integrated USDT0, enabling developers to transfer USD₮ across multiple supported chains without managing cross-chain bridges themselves. These two first-hand sources can be cross-checked to confirm the investment target and existing product, but the investment amount was not disclosed in Tether’s announcement, so we can’t speculate about how much additional on-chain capital was involved.

Why should ETH traders pay attention? If real demand for stablecoin payments grows over the long term, it could improve use cases across the crypto payment network. But Stables emphasizes multichain support and local on- and off-ramps; the announcement does not promise to shift settlement to Ethereum mainnet, nor does it disclose any direct ETH purchases, increased ETH staking, or higher Ethereum fee revenue from the investment. My view is that this is more of a stablecoin distribution and payment-channel story. Any benefit to ETH depends on which chains are actually used for settlement and how many transactions and fees they generate. Calling “funding for a payments company” “new buying demand for ETH” skips the most important link in the chain.

The market reaction is also a reminder to stay cautious. When I checked Binance’s 24-hour ETH/USDT spot data, ETH was around $1,775.38, down about 2.66% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,751.39 to $1,843.49. The news did not immediately lift ETH out of its weakness; of course, price action alone cannot prove that the decline was caused by the funding announcement. The Farside table shows net outflows of about $8.4 million from US ETH funds on November 16, while the row for November 17 was still blank. A blank entry should not be treated as an outflow for that day. Around 1751 is the defense level for this intraday move; 1800–1810 is the first zone that needs to be reclaimed, and around 1843 is the 24-hour high. These levels need to be checked again as the market moves.

If I were trading this myself, I’d stay out for now and only consider a no-leverage spot long, with a single position capped at 3% of total capital. The entry trigger would be a one-hour close above $1,810, followed by a retest that holds $1,800, with no new ETF outflows or exchange security news disrupting the setup. If the trigger doesn’t occur, I stay flat. If it does, the first target is $1,845; I’d take half off there and watch $1,880 with the remainder. The initial stop would be a one-hour close below $1,780; if $1,751 is decisively lost, I’d close the entire position. If official updates later show that payments are mainly routed through other chains, or ETH fails to reclaim $1,800, I’d abandon the assumption that “payment expansion brings marginal gains to ETH.” This is a conditional plan, not a trade that has already been executed.

Next, we should verify settlement volumes by chain and actual merchant usage at Stables; not all growth in USD₮ should be counted as growth for ETH.

#TetherCapitalMakesStrategicInvestmentInStables #ETH
This is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是先看实际落地和价格承接，暂不因为一条融资新闻追ETH。币安广场正在讨论#TetherCapitalMakesStrategicInvestmentInStables；Tether Capital在11月17日的官方声明确认，对跨境支付公司Stables作出战略投资，目标是扩展亚洲和中东的USD₮企业收付基础设施。Tether称Stables已覆盖超过160个市场，年处理USD₮交易量超过20亿美元，并通过一个接口连接本地银行、支付系统与稳定币结算。Stables自己在今年5月宣布接入USDT0，支持开发者在多条受支持链之间转移USD₮，无需自己管理跨链桥。这两份一手信息可以相互核对投资对象与既有产品，但投资金额未在这次Tether公告里给出，不能臆测新增了多少链上资金。

它为什么值得ETH交易者看？稳定币的真实支付需求若长期增加，可能改善整个加密支付网络的使用场景；但Stables强调的是多链与本地出入金，公告没有承诺把结算集中迁往以太坊主网，也没有披露新投资直接购买ETH、增加ETH质押或提高以太坊手续费收入。我的判断是，这更像稳定币分发和支付渠道的事件，ETH的收益取决于后续实际在哪些链结算、产生多少交易和费用。把“支付公司融资”直接写成“ETH新增买盘”是跳过了最关键的传导环节。

后续应核对Stables的链别结算量和真实商户使用，不能把所有USD₮增长都算作ETH增长。

#TetherCapitalMakesStrategicInvestmentInStables #ETH

title: ETF Flow Stabilization and the $60,000 Test: Macro Pressure and Rotation Across $BTC, $ETH, and $BNB
subTitle:
Crypto majors are consolidating under persistent macro pressure and post-liquidation caution. $BTC trades at $63,775.62 (-1.35%) inside a $63,336-$65,534.94 daily range on $1,814.73M spot volume. $ETH changes hands at $1,773.41 (-2.79%) with $605.22M in volume, while $BNB holds relatively steady at $585.05 (-0.76%).

1. Macro Headwinds and Leverage Flush
Hotter-than-expected US October CPI data (up 0.4% month-over-month) and elevated Treasury yields have pushed back Federal Reserve rate-cut expectations. During the recent slide toward the 7-day low of $62,006, derivatives markets flushed roughly $1.9B to $2B in leveraged positions within 24 hours, primarily wiping out overextended longs. With high correlation to tech equities, traders are also watching Nvidia earnings as a cross-market sentiment catalyst.

2. Spot ETF Flows and Options Hedging
Institutional flows remain fragile. After enduring a 7-to-11-session outflow streak totaling roughly $1.9B to $2.35B, US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted a slim $7.9M aggregate net inflow as BlackRock IBIT added $76.5M, largely offset by ongoing redemptions from GBTC and FBTC. Meanwhile, open interest on $60,000 Bitcoin put options has climbed toward $900M, underscoring heavy downside hedging around that psychological floor.

3. Key Levels and Sector Rotation
For $BTC, immediate support sits at $62,000-$63,300, with $60,000 acting as the critical line of defense; upside resistance stands at $65,500-$66,000. $ETH faces support between its 7-day low of $1,711.08 and $1,750, with resistance at $1,843.49. $BNB continues to show relative resilience above its $566 weekly low, facing near-term resistance around $595.50.

While majors digest macro uncertainty, speculative capital has selectively rotated into oversold altcoins and short-squeeze setups. A sustained trend reversal for majors likely requires consistent spot ETF inflows alongside calmer macro yields.

title: ETF 弱势止血与 $60,000 保卫战：$BTC、$ETH 与 $BNB 宏观承压下的板块轮动观察
subTitle:
过去 24 小时加密市场继续在宏观逆风与杠杆出清中寻找平衡。$BTC 现报 $63,775.62（-1.35%），日内区间 $63,336-$65,534.94，现货成交额 $1,814.73M；$ETH 现报 $1,773.41（-2.79%），24h 成交额 $605.22M；$BNB 现报 $585.05（-0.76%），整体抗跌性相对突出。

一、宏观利率与全网清算余波
美国 10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4% 偏热，叠加美债收益率维持高位，市场对美联储降息的预期进一步后移。此前大盘回踩 7 日低点 $62,006 附近时，全网衍生品曾爆发单日约 $1.9B-$2B 的多头强平潮，高杠杆泡沫得到阶段性清洗。当前科技股与加密资产联动紧密，市场正密切关注英伟达财报对风险偏好的外溢影响。

二、现货 ETF 资金流与期权防御信号
资金面上，美国现货比特币 ETF 在经历此前连续 7-11 个交易日合计约 $1.9B-$2.35B 的大幅净流出后，最新单日凭借贝莱德 IBIT 净流入 $76.5M 勉强止血；但受 GBTC 与 FBTC 持续赎回拖累，全市场净流入仅 $7.9M，机构买盘仍以防御为主。同时，期权市场 $60,000 看跌期权未平仓合约已攀升至约 $900M，反映专业资金对下方关键心理关口的密集对冲需求。

三、主流币关键区间与轮动逻辑
1. $BTC：短期支撑关注 $62,000-$63,300 区域，若有效跌破则需警惕 $60,000 期权密集区测试；上方阻力看 $65,500-$66,000。
2. $ETH：弱势回踩 7 日低点 $1,711.08 上方，当前支撑 $1,711-$1,750，阻力位 $1,843.49。
3. $BNB：运行于 7 日区间 $566-$689.30 下沿附近，$580 附近存在承接，短线阻力 $595.50。

整体来看，大盘缩量筑底期间，部分活跃资金正转向超跌小市值及空头挤压山寨标的做局部轮动，大盘重拾趋势仍需 ETF 持续净流入与宏观流动性改善确认。
